tasks.label: start Android Emulator 1
args: $sdk = Join-Path $env:LOCALAPPDATA 'Android\sdk'; $emulator = Join-Path $sdk 'emulator\emulator.exe'; $adb = Join-Path $sdk 'platform-tools\adb.exe'; $device = 'emulator-5554'; if (-not (& $adb devices | Select-String $device)) { Start-Process $emulator -ArgumentList '-avd','Medium_Phone_API_36.1','-port','5554'; } & $adb -s $device wait-for-device; do { Start-Sleep -Seconds 2; $boot = (& $adb -s $device shell getprop sys.boot_completed 2>$null).Trim(); } while ($boot -ne '1'); & $adb -s $device shell wm size 1080x2340; & $adb -s $device shell wm density 450; & $adb -s $device shell settings put system font_scale 1.0; & $adb -s $device shell settings put system accelerometer_rotation 0; & $adb -s $device shell settings put system user_rotation 1
